templates.pattern: A=1, B=2, C=3... Decode: [CODE]
templates.explanation: A1Z26 cipher: numbers map to letters. 3-1-20 = C-A-T

templates.pattern: ROT13 cipher. Decode: [WORD]
templates.explanation: ROT13: shift each letter 13 positions. URYYB → HELLO

templates.pattern: Reverse alphabet: A=Z, B=Y, C=X... Decode: [CODE]
templates.explanation: Atbash cipher: A↔Z, B↔Y. ZYX → ABC

templates.pattern: Morse code. Decode: [MORSE]
templates.explanation: Standard Morse: .-=A, -...=B. Decode each group.

templates.pattern: NATO phonetic: [CODE] stands for which letter?
templates.explanation: Alpha=A, Bravo=B, Charlie=C, Delta=D, Echo=E, Foxtrot=F

templates.pattern: Reverse code: [WORD] backwards is?
templates.explanation: Simply reverse the letters: CAT → TAC, LIVE → EVIL

templates.pattern: Pig Latin: [WORD] in Pig Latin is?
templates.explanation: Move first consonant(s) to end, add 'ay': CAT→ATCAY, DOG→OGDAY

templates.pattern: Mirror digits: 1↔9, 2↔8, 3↔7, 4↔6, 5↔5. Decode: [CODE]
templates.explanation: Mirror each digit: 1→9, 9→1. 19→91, 28→82

templates.pattern: Number sum: A=1, B=2... Word [WORD] letter values sum to?
XOR cipher: [X] XOR [Y] = ?
Caesar cipher shift +[N]. Decode: [WORD]
templates.explanation: Caesar shift back N places: BCD with shift+1 → ABC

templates.pattern: Vowel encode: A=1,E=2,I=3,O=4,U=5. Encode word [WORD]
templates.explanation: Replace vowels with numbers: CAT→C1T, DOG→D4G, BIRD→B3RD

templates.pattern: Symbol code: ☆=A, ★=B, ○=C, ●=D. Decode: [SYMBOLS]
Alternate case: [WORD] starting uppercase alternating?
templates.explanation: HELLO → HeLlO, WORLD → WoRlD, CODE → CoDe

templates.pattern: Phone keypad: 2=ABC, 3=DEF, 4=GHI, 5=JKL. [NUMBERS] last press letter?
templates.explanation: Count presses: 222=C (3rd of ABC), 333=F (3rd of DEF)

templates.pattern: Skip cipher: Take every 2nd letter from [TEXT]. What word?
templates.explanation: ABCDEF → every 2nd = ACE. XAYBZC → every 2nd = ABC

templates.pattern: Polybius square row [R] col [C]. Which letter? (A=11,B=12,C=13...)
templates.explanation: Row 1: A B C D E. Row 2: F G H I K. Row 3: L M N O P. Position = (R-1)*5+C

templates.pattern: Color initial code: [C1], [C2], [C3]. First letters form what word?
templates.explanation: Take first letter of each color: Red,Blue,Green → RBG

templates.pattern: Grid code 3×3: A-I grid. Position row [R] col [C] = ?
templates.explanation: 3×3 grid: Row1=ABC, Row2=DEF, Row3=GHI. (1,1)=A, (2,2)=E, (3,3)=I

templates.pattern: Binary pairs: A=00, B=01, C=10, D=11. Decode [BINARY]
templates.explanation: Split into pairs: 00=A, 01=B, 10=C, 11=D. 0001=AB, 1011=CD

templates.pattern: Substitution: A=@, B=&, C=#. Encode [WORD]
templates.explanation: Replace A→@, B→&, C→#. ABC→@&#, CAB→#@&

templates.pattern: Keyboard row cipher: QWERTY row 1. [WORD] all from same row?
templates.explanation: QWERTYUIOP=row1, ASDFGHJKL=row2, ZXCVBNM=row3. All same row = yes

templates.pattern: Letter product: A=1, B=2, C=3... [WORD] letter values multiply to?
Double shift: Shift +[N] then reverse. Encode [WORD]
templates.explanation: Step1: shift +N. Step2: reverse result. ABC+1=BCD, reversed=DCB

templates.pattern: Odd-Even split: Odd positions = [ODD], Even positions = [EVEN]. Original word?
templates.explanation: Interleave: pos1=C,pos2=A,pos3=T → CAT. Odd=CT,Even=A → CAT
